bridge.comment: Gaze dirs key by take_name; annotations key by take_uid; splits.json keys by take_uid. takes.json (list of take dicts) bridges them. Each take entry: take_name, take_uid, capture.capture_name/uid, task_name, duration_sec, frame_aligned_videos.

projection.notes: The *_2d.csv is already projected to RGB image pixels (1408x1408). Normalize by frame_dims if normalized coords are wanted. The non-2d CPF csv (yaw/pitch/depth) exists too but is angular; prefer the _2d. No validity/depth column in the _2d files.

join.comment: annotations[take_uid] = list of passes; each pass has descriptions[] of {text, timestamp, subject, ego_visible, unsure}. Drop passes where rejected==true (empty descriptions). Flatten passes -> point events. Intersect keys with takes.json take_uids (atomic file holds uids not downloaded here).

annotations[take_uid] = list of expert entries; each has task_name (entry-level) + commentary_data[] of {text, video_time, duration_approx, error}. Drop items where error==true. Treat video_time as start; end = video_time + duration_approx (duration_approx preserved as extra).

anchor.detail: gaze t_s is absolute device us/1e6; t0=first gaze sample == video frame 0 (span 110.78s ~= video 110.93s)

gaze.note: gaze 10Hz; or use frame_num if present

annotations.note: atomic timestamp + expert video_time are already video-zero seconds

epoch_sync.verified: gaze span 110.78s vs video 110.93s; anno atomic 2.6-107.6, expert 2.1-141 (expert runs past video end, preserved)

metadata.notes: Split (train/val/test) is in annotations_*/annotations/splits.json -> take_uid_to_split, NOT in takes.json. test takes have no annotation files (will be dropped by emit policy: no annotation).

provenance.notes: METADATA v2/takes.json (capture_name<->capture_uid, task name, clip uid/paths, gaze paths). VIDEO v2/takes/takes/<TAKE>/frame_aligned_videos/aria01_214-1.mp4 (RGB one of 4). GAZE v2/take_eye_gaze/takes/<TAKE>/eye_gaze/personalized_eye_gaze_2d.csv (fallback general_eye_gaze_2d.csv). ANNOTATIONS: atomic (text+timestamp under descriptions, by uid) and expert (task name; text, video_time, duration_approx).
decisions: Episode = take; enumerate on-disk take dirs (~5009).
RGB video selected by invariant suffix *214-1.mp4 (device prefix aria0N varies); prefer takes.json frame_aligned_videos[*].rgb.relative_path.
Gaze = *_2d.csv (already RGB pixels); prefer personalized (~15% of takes), fall back general (~100%).
Two point/interval annotation channels: atomic (point events) and expert (intervals via video_time+duration_approx).
Per emit policy (video+gaze+>=1 anno), test-split takes and the ~1159 takes with neither annotation are dropped.
corrections: Video path has doubled takes/takes/ and device prefix varies (not always aria01).
Gaze dirs key by take_name; annotations + splits key by take_uid; takes.json bridges (recorded in episode.bridge).
Atomic/expert payload is nested under top-level 'annotations' key; atomic has a rejected-pass layer above descriptions.
Split lives in splits.json, not takes.json.
open_questions: Confirm gaze channel policy: prefer-personalized-else-general (current) vs standardize on general for whole-dataset consistency.
Atomic timestamp is a point; expert is start+duration. Confirm mapping point/interval annotations to the canonical timeline (seconds vs frame_num via fps) at rectify time.
Exact personalized-vs-general counts were sampled (n=400 -> ~15% personalized); a full count was blocked by NFS latency.
